### Documentation checklist

<!-- Remove items that do not apply -->

- [ ] Is there a [changelog entry](https://developers.cloudorbitum.com/style-guide/changelog-entries/)? If you don't add one for something new (however small), how will our customers find out?
- [ ] The change follows the [style guide](https://developers.cloudorbitum.com/style-guide/), and examples use sample data only (`acme-demo`, `example.com`, `203.0.113.0/24`).
- [ ] For a larger change, such as a new page, an issue is linked.
- [ ] Renamed, moved or deleted pages are listed with their old and new URLs, so a redirect can be added.
- [ ] Visual changes use design-system tokens only and work in light and dark mode.
- [ ] `npm run check`, `npm run build` and `npm run lint:docs` pass locally.
